about: Labelled ads for measuring the scam warnings. 'scam': true means the ad shows a known fake-listing or payment-scam pattern a buyer should stop at (FBI IC3, FTC, NICB, Craigslist guidance; 'basis' names it). 'scam': false ads are legitimate but use the same words innocently, to measure false alarms. All 'synthetic' cases are written for this test from those published patterns; 'real' ones come from actual listings (personal details removed).
